assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production game texture, a seamless square land-temperate ALBEDO material, to be clipped by existing continent masks for the 30 planets of a Yautja clan warfare strategy atlas. Generate one full-bleed 1024x1024 texture, strict orthographic satellite nadir view from orbit, no perspective. Subject: temperate alien landmass interior only, dense muted moss green forest canopy, branching river valleys, weathered slate mountain ridges, subdued olive grassland patches. Very fine natural satellite detail, convincing rock erosion and drainage, no individual trees in perspective. No coastline, no ocean, no planet sphere, no space, no stars, no border, no labels, no text, no city, no recognizable Earth geography. Lighting: flat neutral diffuse albedo, minimal baked shadow, no global illumination gradient, no atmospheric haze, no clouds, no halo, no scattering, no vignette. Seamless wrap on all four edges, coherent feature sizes, evenly distributed detail, no focal point. Palette desaturated forest green #425847, olive #68755a, dark slate #344248, small warm exposed stone. Fill every pixel with land material. These are original project worlds, not official film cartography.
assets.observation: Vue satellite de massifs forestiers tempérés et vallées; aucun océan, nuage ou éclairage global. Matière native conservée.

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: independent RGBA cloud texture layer for a planetary globe shader. Generate one square 1024x1024 texture of sparse white and cool pale gray CIRRUS clouds as seen straight down from orbit. Wispy feathered filaments, thin broken cloud bands, natural turbulent detail, fine soft translucent edges. Cover around 35 percent with clouds, leave clear true transparent gaps throughout and especially broad interconnected gaps. Strict orthographic satellite top view, absolutely no terrain, no water, no planet sphere, no space, no sky background, no lighting glow, no halo, no text, no frame, no ground shadows. Only white cloud pixels with soft partial alpha on a genuinely transparent background, not a black background or a checkerboard painted into the image. Uniform orbital scale across the whole square, tileable on all four borders, no large central focal object. Flat illumination so a renderer can apply sunlight separately. Production quality detailed bitmap.
assets.observation: Calque natif indépendant; aucune surface ni planète incluse. La densité effective est modulée par le shader.

assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached ash texture. Preserve the soft charcoal gray volcanic ash whisps and their fine grain, but REMOVE the continuous white background and the continuous gray-white full-canvas fog. Create a production-ready independent atmospheric overlay on REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA. The final image must contain ONLY 5 or 6 separate narrow irregular gray ash plumes drifting diagonally, isolated from each other, with soft translucent fading edges, over an otherwise empty transparent square. At least 65% of the pixels fully transparent, clear empty background showing between the plumes and in large parts of each corner. No white canvas, no black canvas, no checkerboard painted into image. Ash is subtle neutral gray with finer scattered flecks, viewed straight down from orbit. No terrain, no sphere, no landscape, no lighting halo, no text. Keep square full size, create actual alpha transparency. This revision fixes the previous unusable opaque full-image background.
assets.previousAttempt: Premier PNG rejeté : fond opaque détecté par le contrôle alpha. Version corrigée avec image_gen en mode édition; original conservé hors du pack.
assets.observation: Voile de cendres dense; alpha à contrôler, intensité réduite dans la recette.
